newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: United States wins world's richest pigeon race.
newsitem.headline: United States wins world's richest pigeon race.

text.p: The United States on Saturday won the million dollar World Free Flight pigeon race -- said to be the world's richest-- ahead of Belgium and Germany.

"It's Worth A Flutter", entered by an unknown American contestant living in London, flew the 609 km (400 miles) distance from the centre of South Africa to the Sun City resort in the north, at an average speed of 87 km per hour (54 miles per hour) to take the first prize of $250,000.
The winning bird took six hours and 54 minutes to reach the resort.
Sun City, a two-hour drive north of Johannesburg, is home to one of the world's richest golf tournaments, the Million Dollar Golf Challenge.
